description: Hi! I'm a STEM high school student building an autonomous, computer-vision-based solar panel cleaning and dust-detection robot using Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, YOLOv8 Nano, and Python. Passionate about renewable energy and automation. Looking for teammates skilled in data analysis, hardware, or software to optimize efficiency and build an impactful prototype!
summary:
Solar IX is an autonomous, Internet of Things (IoT) capable, solar panel cleaning and environment monitoring robot that aims to solve the problem of dust accumulation on the solar panels which affects the efficiency of renewable energy production. The device uses a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W microprocessor, together with YOLOv8 Nano computer vision to detect the presence of dust particles and activate the cleaning mechanism.

In order to solve the "Be An Earth System Trend Detective" problem, the system takes advantage of NASA Earth observing data (NASA POWER Aerosol and Solar Irradiance datasets) and analyzes the environmental trends in order to determine the occurrence of the next dust storms. In combination with ground robot telemetry, we can provide a decision-making dashboard that will define statistically important reductions in energy production.
details: Project Title: Solar IX Problem: Become An Earth System Trend Detective 1. What does it do or how does it work? Solar IX is an autonomous robotic system integrated with IoT features to continuously monitor and clean solar panels. It consists of a camera unit connected with a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W using a YOLOv8 Nano computer vision model to analyze the amount of dust contamination in real-time. When the dust contamination level crosses the threshold where it affects energy production significantly, the robot takes necessary actions for cleaning. 2. What tools, programming languages, or hardware did you use? -Hardware: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, Pi Camera Module, L298N motor controller, DC motors, 18650 Li-ion batteries, and specifically designed chassis with brushing equipment. -Software & Languages: Python, OpenCV, Ultralytics YOLOv8 for edge inference, and requests library for atmospheric data acquisition. -NASA Integration: The system uses NASA POWER API to pull local Earth observation datasets—Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD), or solar irradiance, to correlate satellite data with ground robotic telemetry and have the possibility to monitor changes. 3. What advantages and purpose does it produce Dust buildup leads to large energy reduction in solar farms (up to 20-30%). Solar IX automatizes the maintenance process without wasting the much needed and precious water (dry-cleaning system), thus improving the efficiency of renewable energy and lowering the operating costs, while producing green energy in dry areas. 4. How is your idea innovative? With traditional scheduled or manual cleaning, Solar IX utilizes edge AI and satellites for the analysis of the oceans. This allows Solar IX as a decision support system to analyze the statistically significant changes in the environment and determine whether or not cleaning is necessary based on the actual weather conditions.
